finviz.name: Finviz
finviz.intro: Finviz is a well-known screener for filtering stocks by criteria. Analects 2.17 takes a different approach: instead of manually filtering, every mid and large-cap company is pre-scored and pre-ranked on ~70 fundamental metrics, and you can reweight the whole model live.

rows.them: Free tier available; paid tiers priced separately — check their site for current pricing

rows.feature: Live weight sliders (whole universe re-ranks instantly)
rows.us: Yes — per category and per metric
rows.them: Screener/filter-based; not a live-reweighted composite score

rows.us: Yes, every company scored the same way
rows.them: Filter on individual metrics; no single blended score
Screen on demand across a broader universe including small caps
CSV export available on paid tiers

rows.us: 7 days, full access, no card tricks

stock-rover.name: Stock Rover
stock-rover.intro: Stock Rover is a broader research and portfolio-tracking platform. Analects 2.17 is narrower and sharper by design: one ranked list, one score, and a live model you can reweight in seconds — no portfolio import required to get value from it.

rows.them: Premium tiers priced significantly higher — check their site for current pricing

rows.feature: Live weight sliders (whole universe re-ranks instantly)
rows.us: Yes — per category and per metric
rows.them: Custom scoring exists but works differently, not a live cross-sectional re-rank
More configuration and portfolio-management depth — steeper learning curve

rows.us: Ranking + explainability: percentile and rank shown per metric, per company
rows.them: Broader research, screening, and portfolio-tracking platform
